_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA Corporation is the worldwide leader in visual computing technologies and the inventor of the graphic processing unit, or the GPU, a high-performance processor which generates realistic, interactive graphics on workstations, personal computers, game consoles, and mobile devices.' 'The market for GPUs, MCPs, and computer-on-a-chip products that support netbooks, PNDs, PMPs, PDAs, cellular phones or other handheld devices is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'Additionally, we expect that Intel and AMD will extend this strategy to other segments, including the possibility of successfully integrating a central processing unit, or CPU, and a GPU on the same chip, as evidenced by AMD’s announcement of its Fusion processor project.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and is currently experiencing a severe downturn, which has harmed and may continue to harm our financial results.' 'In February 2009, Intel filed suit against us, related to a patent license agreement that we signed with Intel in 2004.' (FY2009 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -64.3%/yr (worst year FY00-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +88.9%/yr (Q4 FY10 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +88.9%/yr (FY00-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +147.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2010-01-15) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.07x (87.3% downside to Bear $2.18 / +1278.6% upside to Bull $235.87) | Adj composite 3.20 vs market 1.00: gap +2.20 [UNDERVALUED] | -13% above the EPP floor $19.65 (15x FY10E $1.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +702.5% total (+351.3%/yr) | At 13.1x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $22.63 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +0.6% YoY in Q3 FY10, forward revenues +91.5% (Q4 FY10 revenue guide (Q3 FY10 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
